text: Reads numeric, HapMap, VCF genotypes; applies sample marker QC; optionally imputes missing calls; builds checks genomic relationship matrix; writes auditable result files.

text: grm_file Path square GRM CSV whose first column contains genotype IDs. output_dir Directory receiving optimization outputs. candidate_ids_file Optional candidate-ID CSV; `NULL` derives candidates GRM. target_ids_file Target-ID CSV required targeted optimization. run_label Prefix used output files. id_col Genotype-ID column candidate target files. optimization_mode Either `"targeted"` `"no_test"`. training_size Number candidate genotypes selected. criterion STPGA design criterion. lambda Positive ridge parameter passed STPGA. stpga_n_pcs Optional fixed PC count; `NULL` selects cumulative variance. stpga_pc_variance_target, stpga_max_pcs Automatic PC-selection controls. ga_population, ga_elite, ga_iterations, ga_min_before_stop Genetic-algorithm controls. ga_mutation_prob, ga_mutation_intensity Mutation controls. ga_replicates, ga_seed, ga_cores Replication, seed, parallel controls. random_replicates, random_seed Random benchmark controls. overwrite_outputs Permit replacement outputs run label.
